title: Internet addiction
intro: The internet is a useful tool – but it must never become our master.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “Take advantage of five things before five others: your youth before your old age, your health before your illness, your wealth before your poverty, your free time before you are busy, and your life before your death.” (Al-Hakim)
Our time has brought many useful things, but also some that harm people and society. One of them is internet addiction, especially to social media.

Internet addiction is using the internet too much, in a way that harms our physical or mental health and makes it hard for us to get along with people. More and more, people talk through the internet instead of face to face. It is not rare to see people sitting together while each one looks at their phone.

Every day we see that when young people visit a café, the first thing they want to know is the Wi-Fi password. Examples like this show how far the internet – meant to make life easier – has become, for some people, their main concern and a constant part of life. When this behaviour becomes uncontrollable and an everyday obsession, we call it internet addiction.

The harm of every bad habit, and of using the internet too much, is great. Like alcohol and drugs, internet addiction harms a person’s body and mind. Even more dangerous is when young people use the internet in a wrong way – for example by making fake profiles on social media – without thinking about the consequences.

items: planning one thing, but the internet takes over and you do something else,
feeling worried and tense when there is no internet,
trying to change, but not trying hard enough,
using the internet more and more for many things at school, in the family and with others.

learn.html: The internet cannot replace real time with people. It is not good when, because of it, we neglect normal daily needs. If we notice we can no longer control it, if people around us complain more and more about it, or if we feel guilty about how much time we spend online, we should look for help – and here, talking to someone is the best help.

Allah (SWT) has forbidden people everything that harms their mental and physical health. Since doctors now diagnose too much internet use as an illness of addiction, we can conclude that its harm is great. For a believer, Allah’s pleasure and the mental and physical health needed for worship and daily life come first – and that is the best protection from internet addiction.

items: keeping track of the time you spend online yourself – using the internet too much has no purpose or benefit,
joining groups and activities – especially if you are very shy, it helps to take part in real-life activities,
growing your circle of friends and spending more time with people – the more time with friends and family, the less time online.

learn.title: 💡 Tip
learn.html: Most phones and tablets have a screen-time setting that shows how long you were online each day. Check it with your parents and agree on a fair daily limit – and keep phones away from the table and from Salah.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: The internet should be a tool we use for learning, fast communication and finding information – it must never make us addicts controlled by the internet and social media.

practice.title: Signs of internet addiction
practice.prompt: Tap every warning sign, then tap Check.

options.text: ⏰ You lose track of time online
😰 You feel tense when there is no Wi-Fi
📚 You planned homework but scrolled all evening instead
🔁 You keep saying you’ll stop, but don’t try hard
🔍 You look up a hadith for your maktab homework
options.why: Using the internet for learning is a good use of it.

options.text: 📞 You call your grandmother on video
options.why: Fast communication with family is one of the useful sides of the internet.

Reading the news once a day

questions.q: What should the internet be for a Muslim?
options: A tool for learning and communication

practice.title: Questions and tasks
prompts: 🩺 How does using the internet too much affect our health?
📱 How much time do you spend online each day (on a computer or a phone)? Check your screen time.
🤔 Could your need for the internet be even a small part of an addiction?
🏥 Task 1: are there centres in our country that help people with internet addiction? How many are there here, and how many in the world?
📅 Task 2: make a table of your daily activities and plan your time. It is the best way to protect yourself from using the internet too much.
